column1: # Runnable model bundles from the HuggingFace repo zhou-lab/methscope, at the
# tag in TAGS. Each is self-contained -- the MRMP feature definition travels
# inside the bundle -- so a query .cg runs against one directly.
# Upstream is one flat directory with a single manifest at the repo ROOT (hence
# the empty remote_sub), holding both human and mouse bundles. The store does
# not have to copy that: each row below takes the files matching its prefix, so
# the hg38 bundles file under hg38 and the mouse one under mm10, where someone
# asking "what is there for mm10" will actually look. Both rows share the one
# upstream manifest and therefore the one anchor.
